---
name: Feature or change request
about: You wish it could do something, or do something differently. Not a crash — a design decision that hurts.
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

<!-- One or two plain sentences are enough to start. -->

**1. What do you wish you could do — or what should change?**
<!-- The feature, the default you would prefer, the message you would rather read, the button you want. -->

**2. Why do you need it, and how would you use it?**
<!-- The real task behind the request. This is what tells us which of several designs fits how you work. -->

**3. What do you do today instead?**
<!-- Other tools, extra steps, config you changed. Stops us rebuilding a workaround you already rejected. -->

**4. How often does this bite you?**
- [ ] every run
- [ ] weekly
- [ ] now and then
- [ ] once, but it cost me time

**5. Would you test it?**
- [ ] yes, happy to try a branch or build
- [ ] yes, if it is a package or one-command install
- [ ] not able to test

**6. Anything else**
<!-- Screenshots of the confusing screen, examples of files involved, your machine details only if you think
this is machine-specific (then run ./scripts/bugreport.sh and paste it). -->
